about: What an editor may say when a sample opens (samples.spec.ts). `informational` lists the starts of standing notes that describe what a feature class supports, and are not gaps of the sample. `notices` lists, per sample, each notice a known gap causes: `notice` is the whole text for Visio and PowerPoint (code and message) and its opening words for Word and Excel, and `gap` is text from the open item in docs/parity-checklist.md that owns it. Both lists may only shrink (check-baseline.mjs): remove an entry in the commit that closes its gap.
informational: Fields show the result Word last saved while editing
Formatting-change revisions retain their prior run-properties snapshots
Paragraph and character styles resolve supported formatting
Theme colors and fonts resolve for rendering
Numbering is resolved for decimal, Roman numeral, letter
Table grid widths, merges, borders, shading
PAGE, NUMPAGES, SECTIONPAGES, DATE and TIME fields are recalculated in Print Layout
Comment ranges are modeled at run granularity
Inline pictures render from their original bytes
render: Text metrics and automatic wrapping use browser fonts
